turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm writing up the initial pitch deck for the Sleep Mode feature. I need the headline stats for the intro slide.
Sure. What numbers do you want to highlight for the performance boost?
Just stick with the early prototype data. It shows a 5–12× speedup based on vLLM's official blog data. Keep it conservative for now.
Got it. I'll note the 5–12× range. Did you want to mention the hardware requirements on that same slide?
No, keep the slide clean. Oh, by the way, did the package with the new mechanical keyboard switches arrive yet? My old ones are getting sticky.
I don't see a delivery confirmation for the switches in your email history yet. Want me to check the tracking link?
Yeah, do that. Also, it's pouring rain outside, so I might just stay in and test the keyboard once it gets here.
I'll keep an eye on the tracking. The 5–12× stat is saved for your draft.
Lloyd, we've finalized the vLLM integration. The early prototype numbers are outdated. Please update the pitch deck notes.
What are the new performance metrics?
Sleep Mode demonstrates an 18–203× speedup based on vLLM's official blog data. Use this for all marketing materials now.
Understood. I've updated the records with the 18–203× speedup. Do you want me to draft an email to the sales team about this change?
Not yet. Just update the file. Speaking of which, did you get a chance to track that keyboard order? The rain hasn't let up here in Seattle.
The package is currently in transit, estimated to arrive next Tuesday. The weather forecast for Tuesday is mostly cloudy.
Perfect. Let me know when it's out for delivery. I want to test the switches before the client demo.
Will do. I've flagged the delivery date. The new speedup stats are recorded.
